consequence: 0<=Phi_add(A|B)<=1 whenever Tr_A(U(B)) is nonempty; Phi_add=0 when A is already a free-base trace
proof_steps: Every union in U(B∪{A}) either uses A or does not.
If it does not use A, its trace lies in Tr_A(U(B)).
If it uses A, its intersection with A equals A.
Hence the new trace family adds at most the single trace A.
The log-cardinality increment is at most log2((m+1)/m)<=1 for m>=1.
scope: refutes only target-adjoin normalized free-union trace entropy; does not refute all conditional/incremental potentials
